Experiment_A.boundary_dependency_note: While internal inter-sensor pauses are independent of human intermediate substep annotations, the observation window itself strictly depends on proctor-defined task start/end boundary annotations (X-start, X-end).

pause_cnt_5_int.description: Count of internal inter-sensor inactivity intervals >= 5.0 seconds during task window

max_pause_int.description: Maximum internal inter-sensor inactivity interval during task window

Experiment_B.boundary_dependency_note: Directly includes overall active duration (T_end - T_start), which is 100% determined by human proctor start/end annotations.

pause_cnt_5_int.description: Count of internal inter-sensor inactivity intervals >= 5.0 seconds during task window

max_pause_int.description: Maximum internal inter-sensor inactivity interval during task window

duration.limitation_note: Directly bounded by human proctor start/end tags

classes.0: Class 0: High Task Quality (CASAS Score 1; unassisted/standard execution)
classes.1: Class 1: Degraded Task Quality (CASAS Scores 2, 3, 5, 6; verbal prompt, incomplete, breakdown, or abort)

champion_model.rationale: Selected as primary research champion to maximize reliance on internal sensor interval dynamics rather than total proctor-bounded duration, while acknowledging the dependency on start/end window boundary tags.
